SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE
6353-55 West 55th Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 6353-55 West 55th Street from a RS-2 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District to B3-1 Community Shopping District in order to establisha restaurant
at the subject property. The existing commercial building has sat vacant for over 20 years.
Moreover, the property was originally a B3-1 zoning district, but in 2017 the subject property was
downzoned to an RS-2 by the alderman’s office. The Applicant is simply seeking to bring the
property back to its original zoning district and activate the lot with a restaurant use.

The subject property is improved with a vacant two-story commercial building and provides 37
parking spaces. The restaurant use will occupy approximately 14,169.58 square feet of
commercial space. The existing building’s height of 30.7 feet will remain unchanged. There will
be no dwelling units provided.

Applicant seeks all relief available under the Chicago Zoning Code, as needed, for the
